blogPosts.title: Plumbing Maintenance Tips for Horsham Winters
blogPosts.essential: Essential plumbing maintenance advice for Horsham homeowners to prevent winter-related issues like frozen pipes and leaks.
body: Winter in Horsham can bring cold temperatures that pose risks to plumbing systems, such as frozen or burst pipes. To prevent this, start by insulating exposed pipes in unheated areas like garages or crawl spaces. Use foam insulation sleeves or heating tapes, which are readily available and easy to install. In Horsham, where temperatures can drop below freezing, this simple step can save you from costly emergency repairs. PST Plumbing recommends checking your home's insulation and sealing gaps around windows and doors to keep warm air in and cold air out.

Another key maintenance task for Horsham winters is to ensure your hot water system is in top condition. Before the cold sets in, schedule a professional inspection with PST Plumbing to check for any issues like sediment buildup or faulty components. In Horsham, where hot water usage increases during winter, a well-maintained system ensures efficiency and prevents breakdowns. We also advise setting your water heater to a moderate temperature, around 60 degrees Celsius, to balance comfort and energy savings.

Outdoor plumbing fixtures, such as taps and hoses, need attention too. Disconnect and drain outdoor hoses, and shut off the water supply to exterior taps to prevent freezing. In Horsham, where frost can occur, this protects against pipe bursts. For homes with sprinkler systems, ensure they are properly winterised by draining the lines. PST Plumbing offers winterisation services for Horsham properties, including a thorough check of all outdoor plumbing to avoid surprises during cold snaps.

Inside your home, be mindful of what goes down the drains to prevent clogs, which are more problematic in winter when pipes are more susceptible to freezing. Avoid flushing grease or harsh chemicals, and use drain guards to catch debris. In Horsham, where older plumbing may be more fragile, regular drain cleaning can maintain flow and reduce blockages. Our team uses gentle, effective methods that comply with Australian environmental standards, ensuring your drains stay clear throughout the season.

Monitoring your water bills for unusual increases can indicate hidden leaks, which are common in winter as pipes contract and expand. If you notice a spike, contact PST Plumbing for a leak detection service in Horsham. We use advanced technology to pinpoint leaks without invasive digging, minimising damage and repair costs. Being proactive in Horsham's variable climate helps maintain your plumbing system's integrity and avoids major disruptions.

Finally, if you're planning any renovations or upgrades in Horsham, consider scheduling them before winter to avoid complications. Our expertise in Horsham's local conditions means we use materials and techniques that are durable and weather-appropriate.
